articles.title: From Clunky to Lightning-Fast: How AI Is Teaching Robots to Outrun Humans
articles.summary: A humanoid robot clocked a half-marathon in 50:26, shattering the human record by nearly 7 minutes. In one year, robot race times plunged by over two-thirds. AI-powered vision-language-action models are behind the leap — and they could reshape factories and homes.

articles.title: Heat Waves Are Frying Animal Brains — and the Fallout Could Hit Our Food Supply
articles.summary: Rising temperatures impair learning, fuel aggression, and dull survival instincts across species. Birds, fish, bees, and even dogs show cognitive decline in heat. Scientists warn these effects could cascade through ecosystems and threaten agriculture.

articles.title: Planet Nine Theory Takes a Hit as Newfound Icy World Refuses to Wobble
articles.summary: A newly discovered sednoid, 2023 KQ14, has a stable elliptical orbit — challenging the idea that a hidden giant planet is shepherding distant objects. The finding adds to mounting evidence that Planet Nine, if it exists, must be extremely remote.
